title: 第二十一章 发展大夏特色修仙主义第二十二章 朕不需要你的忠诚
slug: 一统天下后方知此世有仙
content_zh:
谢苍荣摇了摇头，轻叹道：“若真如她所说的话，你我这般心思深重之人，怕是在这修行路上难有建树了~”
话虽如此，可他脸上却是全无半点遗憾的意思，倒像是在说笑。
修行便是修心。
这是另一方天地最为响亮的口号。
修士修佛修道修魔，宣扬开慧悟道，宣扬超然心境，追求此世至理，只不过是对此解释有所不同罢了。
各个宗派都有自己的心经，都有自己的修行智慧。修者追求道心通明，有所领悟，心境提升，修行方可有如神助，进步飞速。
楚湘云被盛赞为天才，根骨优秀是一方面，更重要的则在于她天生道心，不为红尘羁绊。
齐修眉头紧皱，问道：“此人可信么？”
这显然不是一个好消息。
倒不是他忧心自己修行困难。
重点在于，若真如陛下获得的情报所说，修士追求物我两忘，超脱红尘羁绊……那么这样的人是很难驱驰控制的，这样的追求并不利于国家管理。
这对于王朝体制而言并不是一件好事。
而另一边法王大于人王的政治生态，或许也是由这样的先天条件决定的。
“可信！”
想起那性格独特的姑娘，谢苍荣不住笑了笑：“天底下再不会有人比她还可信了。”
接着，却他又微微眯了眯眼，话锋一转：“不过，每个人的思想观念都源于自己固有的认知，虽然她主观上没有想要欺骗朕的意思，但是她却不一定是对的。”
“还请陛下明示。”
齐修需要为未来国家变革做准备、制定律法，每一份情报信息都很重要，谢苍荣作为君王的态度也决定着王朝的发展方向。他需要跟谢苍荣沟通，去进一步了解修行的本质和君王的想法。
谢苍荣想了想，说道：“首先，修行便是修心，这应该是对的。根据现有的情报推断，朕以为，修士的力量源自于内心执念，你自己的意志和认知极为重要。”
整个大夏，作为领袖的谢苍荣可以看到最多的信息，无疑有着最为清晰的视野。现在综合各方情报，谢苍荣暂时得到了一个较为浅薄的结论。

法术神通需要刻苦修炼提升不假，但是根本上来自于内心，都是唯心的力量，想要修行，需在探索世界、启蒙认知之时发自内心接受这些超出理解的力量，然后才有机会萌发出力量的种子。
看到这些力量，感受到这些力量，才有修仙的资格。
修士将这个阶段命名为【开慧】。
仙魔四洲，修士自古存在千万载，早已经形成了成熟的修炼体系和等级制度。
修行悟道早已深入人心，【开慧】这个阶段并不难实现。
但是大夏却不同。
这片浩土大陆，亘古往今，王朝更迭，风云变幻，多是方士骗子，却无一人掌握神通术法。灭法之地，一个修士都没有。虽然有许多幻想和传说，但是没有就是没有，无从开始，从根儿上断绝了可能。
有些事情或许本就是客观存在的，只是人感受不到。就像是人有眼睛，方可认识到事物有色彩，人有耳朵，才会感知到天地有声音……人如果没有这些感官，还会认识到事物有这些特质么？
【开慧】便是赋予认知。
content_en:
Xie Cangrong shook his head and sighed softly: "If it is true what she said, people with such deep thoughts like you and me, I am afraid it will be difficult to achieve anything on this path of cultivation~"
Even so, there was no regret at all on his face, it seemed like he was joking.
To practice is to cultivate the mind.
This is the loudest slogan in the other world.
Monks practice Buddhism, Taoism and demons, preach enlightenment and enlightenment, preach a transcendent state of mind, and pursue the truth of this world. They just have different interpretations of this.
Each sect has its own Heart Sutra and its own wisdom of practice. Practitioners who pursue the Tao must have a clear mind, gain some understanding, and improve their state of mind. Only then will their practice be like divine help and make rapid progress.
Chu Xiangyun was praised as a genius, not only because of her excellent foundation, but more importantly, because she was born with a Taoist heart and was not bound by the world of mortals.
Qi Xiu frowned and asked, "Is this person trustworthy?"
This is obviously not good news.
It’s not that he is worried about difficulties in his practice.
The point is, if it is true, as the information obtained by His Majesty says, that monks pursue the pursuit of forgetfulness of things and themselves, and transcend the fetters of the mortal world... then it is difficult to drive and control such people, and such pursuits are not conducive to the management of the country.
This is not a good thing for a dynastic system.
On the other hand, the political ecology in which the Dharma King is greater than the Human King may also be determined by such innate conditions.
"Believable!"
Thinking of that girl with a unique personality, Xie Cangrong couldn't help but smile: "There is no one in the world who is more trustworthy than her."
Then, he narrowed his eyes slightly and changed the topic: "However, everyone's thoughts and ideas stem from their own inherent cognition. Although she subjectively did not mean to deceive me, she is not necessarily right."
"Your Majesty, please make it clear."
Qi Xiu needs to prepare for future national changes and formulate laws. Every piece of intelligence information is important. Xie Cangrong's attitude as a king also determines the development direction of the dynasty. He needed to communicate with Xie Cangrong to further understand the nature of practice and the king's thoughts.
Xie Cangrong thought for a while and said: "First of all, practice is to cultivate the mind. This should be right. Based on the available information, I believe that the power of a monk comes from inner obsession, and your own will and cognition are extremely important."
Throughout Daxia, as the leader, Xie Cangrong could see the most information and undoubtedly had the clearest vision. Now, based on the intelligence from all parties, Xie Cangrong has temporarily come to a relatively superficial conclusion.
It is true that magical powers require hard practice and improvement, but they fundamentally come from the heart and are all idealistic powers. If you want to practice, you must heartily accept these powers beyond understanding when exploring the world and enlightening your knowledge. Only then will you have the opportunity to germinate the seeds of power.
Only by seeing and feeling these powers can one be qualified to become an immortal.
The monks named this stage [Open Wisdom].
In the four continents of immortals and demons, monks have existed for thousands of years and have already formed a mature cultivation system and hierarchy.
Cultivation and enlightenment have already been deeply rooted in people's hearts, and this stage of "enlightenment of wisdom" is not difficult to achieve.
But Daxia is different.
In this vast continent, through the ages, dynasties have changed, and the situation has changed. Most of them are alchemists and swindlers, but no one has mastered magical powers. There is not a single monk in the land where law is destroyed. Although there are many fantasies and legends, nothing means nothing. There is no way to start, and the possibility is completely cut off.
Some things may exist objectively, but people cannot feel them. Just like people have eyes, they can realize that things have colors, and people have ears, so they can perceive the sounds of heaven and earth... If people don't have these senses, will they still realize that things have these qualities?
[Kaihui] is to give knowledge.
